props.prompt: An industrial high-bay pendant lamp hanging from a short steel rod seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: a wide dented aluminium dome reflector with a rim, a large very bright warm-white glowing lens underneath, a small ballast box on top with a cable gland and a yellow hazard sticker, a little rust, proportions about four wide to three tall.

A ceiling-mounted fluorescent tube batten light seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: a long narrow steel housing with two parallel very bright cool-white glowing tubes behind a thin wire guard cage, end caps with screws, a short conduit stub on top, grime and a faded warning label, proportions about six wide to one tall.

A bare filament light bulb under a small enamelled tin cone shade hanging from a twisted black cord seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: faded green shade with chipped white inside, a very bright warm yellow glowing bulb below it, a brass socket, a strip of tape on the cord, proportions about three wide to four tall.

A slim rectangular LED ceiling light panel seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: a thin white aluminium frame holding a very bright cool-white glowing diffuser with a faint grid of cells, two short suspension brackets on top, a tiny teal status light at one corner, clean clinical look, proportions about six wide to one tall.

A cyberpunk street-market lantern hanging from a hook seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: a rounded red lantern body made of ribbed translucent plastic glowing very bright warm red-orange from inside, black top and bottom caps with thin gold trim, a short tassel made of fibre-optic strands with glowing cyan tips, a small cable running up, proportions about three wide to four tall.

A portable caged work light hanging from a steel hook by its handle seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: an orange rubber handle, a yellow plastic guard cage around a very bright warm-white glowing bulb, a coiled black cable trailing upward, scuffs and paint splatter, proportions about two wide to four tall.

An oval industrial bulkhead wall lamp on a short bracket seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: a heavy grey cast-metal body with four bolts, a thick ribbed glass lens glowing very bright warm amber behind a metal guard grille, a conduit pipe entering from the top, rust streaks below, proportions about four wide to three tall.

A gooseneck barn-style sign lamp on a wall bracket seen from the side: a curved black steel pipe arm ending in a round enamelled dark-teal shade pointing down, a very bright warm-white glowing bulb visible under the shade, a small wall plate with two bolts, a sticker on the arm, proportions about four wide to three tall.

A vertical neon tube wall light on two black standoff brackets seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: a single long glass tube glowing very bright magenta-pink with a thin cyan inner line, small transformer box at the bottom with a dangling wire, black tube end caps, proportions about one wide to five tall.

A wall-mounted industrial hazard warning light box seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: a squat black housing with yellow-black hazard stripes, a wide rectangular lens glowing very bright amber-orange, a small speaker grille and a cable gland on the side, chipped paint, proportions about four wide to three tall.

A wall-mounted security floodlight with a motion sensor seen from the side: a flat black finned LED lamp head tilted downward on a swivel bracket with a very bright cool-white glowing face made of small LED squares, a small grey sensor dome underneath with a tiny red status light, a wall plate, proportions about four wide to three tall.

The head of a modern LED street lamp on a short horizontal arm seen from the side: a slim wedge-shaped dark grey aluminium housing with cooling fins on top, a long flat very bright cool-white glowing LED strip underneath, a small antenna and a solar sensor nub on top, a round clamp at the end of the arm, a faded sticker, proportions about six wide to two tall.

A rooftop aircraft obstruction light on a short steel mast seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: a cylindrical red ribbed glass lamp glowing very bright red with a metal cage, a grey base box with a cable, a small lightning rod spike on top, bird droppings and rust, proportions about two wide to four tall.

A construction work floodlight on a tall yellow tripod stand seen from the front, the lamp is switched on and its light element is the brightest part of the picture: two rectangular lamp heads on a crossbar with very bright warm-white glowing faces behind wire guards, black handles, a thick orange cable wrapped around one leg, mud on the feet, proportions about three wide to six tall.
